returns-reserve
forecast from the
calibrated model
(nobody demos this)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="180" x="900" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rule" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;fontStyle=1" value="DESIGN RULE: no customer-facing penalty, ever. div.div:
DESIGN RULE: no customer-facing penalty, ever. Nothing blocks a purchase. Nothing charges a customer.
The system either gives better information, packs the item better, or fixes a bad listing.
Feature review excludes anything that proxies for demographics; audit the SHAP factors of the top decile.
Separate table, separate UI, separate language from the return-ABUSE plan (N-10). They share only the feature pipeline.

largest single return cause, computable from data
we already have, one sentence on the PDP,
and a clean A/B. Everything else is phase 2.
